limitations: This ledger is evidence of a mechanical audit observation, not proof that a row executes, is legally complete, or duplicates the selected registry revision.
A row may contain both retained mechanics and an actionable declaration; the anchor names the declaration surface that is tracked.
Rows must be compared with the selected model/revision authority before migration. A schema gap may be closed as deferred with a precise reason rather than forcing a lossy generic dictionary.
The broad 654-file prefilter is context only and never contributes to the residual count.

scope.closure_rule: Open, deferred, and unsupported rows are blocking. A row leaves the signal only after a migrated, retained, or bridge disposition passes its required evidence checks; status text alone never closes a row.
scope.included: Non-test Python declarations with a concrete filing-affecting model, casilla, legal, tax, formula, binding, relation, layout, verification, or typed catalogue signal.
